mapper.select: select fv.id, fv.name, fv.unit, fv.fee_key_id, fk.id, fk.name AS fee_key_name from lease.fee_value fv join lease.fee_key fk on fk.id = fv.fee_key_id where fk.is_deleted = 0 and fv.is_deleted = 0 and fv.id in (select fee_value_id from lease.apartment_fee_value where apartment_id = #{id})
